intended_use: Computational detection of residual pluripotent stem cells in single-cell RNA-seq of PSC-derived cell therapy products. Research Use Only — NOT FDA-cleared and not a clinical release test.
out_of_scope_uses: Release testing without orthogonal wet-lab confirmation
Bulk RNA-seq or DNA-based purity assays

training_data_summary.provenance: Synthetic: 6 multi-site simulations (7 countries incl. multi-site US/UK) with batch effects, doublets, ambient RNA, low-quality cells and dropout. Real: pbmc3k (Zheng et al. 2017) as negative reference with cross-batch noise.

limitations: Hybrid training corpus: simulated multi-site differentiation data plus a real PBMC reference; clinical manufacturing data not yet included.
Detection ceiling scales with sequenced cell number; below 0.001% the estimate is dominated by sampling noise.
Batch effects can create false positives — the biomarker cross-check must be reviewed before disposition.
Teratoma site priors are literature-derived (Lee 2013; Ben-David 2013; Brederlau 2004; Hentze 2009; Kroon 2008) and not patient data.
No wet-lab orthogonal validation performed (HEC, ddPCR, lncRNA flow outstanding).
ethical_considerations: scRNA-seq profiles are potentially identifiable and must be handled as PHI under the HIPAA Security Rule. The model must not be used as the sole basis for patient treatment decisions.

regulatory.gmlp: Aligned with the 10 GMLP principles (FDA/Health Canada/MHRA, Oct 2021).
regulatory.pccp: Predetermined Change Control Plan maintained; PCCP-delta emitted on retrain (FDA Dec 2024 guidance).
regulatory.ich_q5e: Comparability study required on every promotion; see comparability_report.json.
regulatory.part11: All training and promotion events are recorded in the append-only audit trail (db/audit.db).

maintenance.retraining_trigger: Calibration drift (KL > 0.10 or KS > 0.15) on two consecutive batches, or annual review.
maintenance.rollback_plan: Restore previous model card + weights snapshot; re-run ICH Q5E comparability; document in CAPA.

notes: Hybrid build — demonstration grade; see paper/wet_lab_limitation.md
